---
title: "Quick start"
---

Enable the WBG theme once, then pass summarized data to an opinionated chart
factory.

```{python}
import attaviz
from vega_datasets import data

attaviz.enable()

source = (
    data.barley()
    .groupby("site", as_index=False)["yield"]
    .mean()
)

attaviz.bar(
    source,
    category="site",
    value="yield",
    title="Barley yield by site",
    subtitle="Mean yield across varieties and years",
)
```

Factories handle recurring editorial choices such as sorting, labels,
tooltips, highlighting, number formatting, and responsive width. They return
ordinary Altair charts, so normal Altair customization remains available.

```python
chart = attaviz.bar(
    source,
    category="site",
    value="yield",
    highlight="Morris",
)

chart = attaviz.frame(
    chart,
    description="Horizontal bars comparing mean barley yield at six sites.",
    source="Minnesota agricultural experiment stations",
)
```

## Size variants

Three typography/spacing presets are available. Pick the one that matches
the intended display width.

```python
attaviz.enable(size="small")   # charts under ~400px wide
attaviz.enable(size="medium")  # 400–700px (default)
attaviz.enable(size="large")   # wider than 700px
```

## Per-chart sizing

To size a single chart without switching the global theme:

```python
chart = attaviz.configure_size(chart, width=600, aspect_ratio="16:9")
```
